name: 76691 · West, TX
findings: ZIP 76691 (West) has 21 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 76691 (West) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
100% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 76691 (West) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.8 times the typical level).
